notes.title: Lost Treasures Adventure Bundle
notes.content:
[h2]Lost Treasures Adventure Bundle[/h2]
Follow pirate heroine Nelly Cootalot in her quest to save endangered waterfowl and seek the treasure of the Seventh Sea. And help Henry Dijon - archaeologist of the future - discover lost treasures in the legendary city of Mutropolis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33051363/706a1e659327c9692e71b29d015224bc7b490d89.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8551/Lost_Treasures_Adventure_Bundle/]Buy the bundle here: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8551/Lost_Treasures_Adventure_Bundle/[/url]

[h2]Mutropolis has launched[/h2]
MUTROPOLIS is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33051363/933bf921bfb0b6e851fb1db82b9669b8d88e6875.jpg[/img]

After five years of hard work by Bea and Pablo (Pirita Studio, Madrid) the new mystery point & click adventure Mutropolis finally has launched. Here are some reactions by the press the product has received:
[list]
[*][i]one of the best adventure games that have appeared in recent years - 100/100[/i]
[url=https://itc.ua/articles/mutropolis-vesyolye-arheologicheskie-raskopki-v-mire-budushhego/]itc.ua, Yuri Melkov[/url]
[*][i]An enjoyable adventure and a first class debut for Pirita Studio - 85/100[/i]
[url=https://ragequit.gr/reviews/item/mutropolis-pc-review/]ragequit.gr, George Dembegiotis[/url]
[*][i]Exciting detective story with great characters and lots of love for archaeology. - 75/100[/i]
[url=https://www.4players.de/4players.php/dispbericht_fazit/PC-CDROM/Test/Fazit_Wertung/PC-CDROM/42788/84769/Mutropolis.html]4players.de, Maja Verfondern[/url]
[*][i]Mutropolis is an absolute recommendation for any point-and-click lover. - 8/10[/i]
[url=https://indieplanet.de/tests/mutropolis-im-test-pc-verrueckte-reise-zurueck-zur-erde/]indieplanet.de, Christina Knauf[/url]
[*][i]interesting puzzles, good humor and a good audio/visual setting 9/10[/i]
[url=https://forum.przygodomania.pl/viewtopic.php?f=1302&t=7732]forum.przygodomania.pl, Urszula Kuchmistrz[/url]
[*][i]a good choice for all fans of point-and-click and logic games 92/100[/i]
[url=https://www.omegascopio.com.br/jogos/mutropolis-e-um-puzzle-desafiador-e-inteligente-critica/]omegascopio.com.br, Julia Barcelos[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Game content finalized
notes.content:
[h1]Getting ready to ship, captain![/h1]
Alasdair has been tweaking and polishing (and breaking and fixing) Nelly Cootalot: Spoonbeaks Ahoy! for many months now. 1920x1080 HD resolution and a FULL VOICE OVER in English are the obvious highlights, but read on for a full list of the improvements we've made to the original 2007 game.

[h1]New resolution[/h1]
The game now runs in full 1920x1080 HD, (as well as other widescreen resolutions). This is flipping massive compared to the tiny, square original graphics (see trailer video).

[h1]Full voice acting (English only)[/h1]
Extremely cheap voice acting by Alasdair Beckett-King, real Nelly and literally no one else. Think of it as a director's commentary where I get to do a load of dodgy accents. (Yes, this feature CAN be switched off.)

[h1]Support for more operating systems[/h1]
Full support for macOS and Linux as well as all recent Windows systems. 

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Streamlined point & click interface.
[*]Improved launcher app.
[*]Bad jokes replaced with good jokes (I wish).
[/list]
[h1]New "business" model[/h1]
[list]
[*] Cheapest price ever.
[*] ABK's year 1 revenue goes to the birds.
[/list]

We've put a lot of work into this remastered edition. However, Spoonbeaks Ahoy! is a shorter game than The Fowl Fleet, and the original was freeware. So we've decided to make this release super, super-cheap. We won't announce the price yet, but we're looking at an amount so small, the publisher will find it hard to discount it.

But that didn't seem like enough. So, for 1 year after launch - after fees and taxes are deducted - Alasdair's share of revenue will go to the RSPB, a British charity taking care of our feathered friends (birds).
